_about: package R2-A2: what the tdial shader needs to colour and animate face_tacho (tools/twin-dial/bake_face.py). theta = degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock = atan2(dx, -dy) of the pixel centre about the dial centre; rho = distance / R. Panel px = face px + rect_panel[0:2].

encoding.byte: the neutral sRGB code (the G channel of the picture) / 255; 0 = black
encoding.note: ticks, numerals, bezel, rim, OFF, end labels, icon: 255 (their antialiased edges blend with the band)

law.what: Y = k exp(a (rho - 0.60)) exp(b (1 - cos theta)), linear light, the G channel (look B)

band.what: the grey scale band (ticks strip included). Only here the tint is applied.

strip.what: the tick strip, constant G code inside band.theta_abs_max; its own tint (the strip is not the band's)

strip_line.what: the bright line at the strip's outer edge (+45 % over the strip in linear light)

major_lines.what: near-black lines across the band at each major mark

ink_numerals.what: every numeral ink pixel lies in this radius range

bezel.what: white ring, open at the bottom, cut square at 143.6 (the tachometer's red arc recolours it from the redline)

rim.what: white inner rim, width 0.008 R, ends with the band and the bezel (SPEC-R3 §2.1)

decode.band_tint: inside regions.band: c_k = max(0, (k_k)^(1/2.4) * (g + 0.055) - 0.055), k = tint_linear * bandGain, per channel; w = 1 - smoothstep(0.70, 0.80, g); rgb = mix(vec3(g), c, w). Outside the band rgb = g. On the strip the tint is regions.strip.tint_linear (and regions.strip_line.tint_linear on its bright line), not the band's. Exact for sRGB(Y*k) while Y*k > 0.0031308 (everywhere in the band at bandGain >= 0.6).
decode.night: multiply in linear light on top (SPEC-R3 §6), per material class: region + luma class
decode.red_arc: tachometer: the bezel ink (rho >= 0.975) from theta(redline) to red_arc.to_deg is sRGB (210, 20, 21); the band stays grey
decode.ink_alpha: red numerals and ticks recolour ink only: the shader mixes the ink colour by the face byte (smoothstep(0.70, 0.85, g))

numeral_shadow.what: baked: the band's codes under and around each numeral are darkened in linear light, Y' = Y (1 - D)

bar.what: frames of the 5 segments are baked (47); the shader fills them (white; first segment red on reserve; last red when hot)

scale.law: 0..8 x 1000 rpm linear, 0 at -125 deg, 8 at +125 deg (31.25 deg per 1000)

red_arc.what: drawn by the shader (u_red.x .. u_red.w) over the bezel ink; no wedge (SPEC-R3 §2.5)

gear.what: GPU text; the face keeps the centre free of ink

red_rules.ticks: red when theta >= theta(redline) - 0.45 deg (half the width of a tick), rho in regions.ink_ticks
red_rules.numerals: a numeral is red when its value >= redline rounded up to 1000: red when theta >= theta(ceil(redline/1000) - 0.5), rho in regions.ink_numerals
red_rules.limit: both only for theta <= 140 deg (scale end + 15, the ink of 8 reaches 131): the bar end label "1/1" and the icon lie at larger theta
